g.text: Set the rig at the crossing. Levels good. Floor -58.
Sixty seconds is nothing. I have held sixty seconds a
thousand times. I have held it in worse rooms than this for
The difference is that this time I am going to be in it.
I would like it on the record that I was not sad, and I was
not haunted, and there was no one I was thinking about. I
was on the clock. It asked. It was going to be rubble on
Thursday and it asked, and I have spent six years being
paid to record rooms that nobody will ever stand in again,
and not one of them ever asked me for anything.
